error.carga: The games could not be loaded

catalogo.vacioTexto: This site stores your collection in this browser and starts empty. Add your first game or import a backup (.json file) from the “Backup” section of Add game.
catalogo.pendienteAviso: This game still needs to be filled in: press “Edit this game” to complete its details.

orden.ariaAsc: Ascending order. Press to reverse it
orden.ariaDesc: Descending order. Press to reverse it

asist.titulo: What shall we play? · My board games
asist.registrada: Play logged. Enjoy! When you finish, rate it above.
asist.nadaTexto: No game in the collection supports that number of players. Time to buy a new one!
asist.vacioTexto: The assistant recommends games from your collection, and it is still empty. Add a game or import a backup from Add game.
asist.relajado: No game matched everything you asked for, so I relaxed {lista}.

jugadores.titulo: How many of you are playing?
jugadores.ayuda: Only games that support that number of players will be considered.

tiempo.titulo: How much time do you have for the game?
tiempo.ayuda: Not counting the rules explanation or setup.
tiempo.o90s: Up to an hour and a half

prep.titulo: How much do you mind the setup?
prep.ayuda: Time to set up the table and deal (estimated).
prep.o3s: Take out the box and play (up to 3 min)

dificultad.titulo: What level of challenge do you fancy?
dificultad.ligeroS: Easy to explain and to play
dificultad.intensoS: I want to think and suffer

modo.ayuda: This question is ignored for solo games.

party.titulo: What kind of atmosphere are you after?
party.siS: Laughs, speed and lots of people

experiencia.titulo: What kind of experience are you after?
experiencia.ayuda: What you most want to feel during the game.

novedad.titulo: Try something new or repeat a favourite?
novedad.ayuda: Uses what you have logged: plays and your 1–5 rating.

motivo.mejorCon: One of the best games for {jug}
motivo.admiteNoIdeal: Supports {jug}, although it is not its ideal number
motivo.cabeRapido: Could finish within your time if it goes quickly ({dur})
motivo.reciente: You played it less than a week ago

crear.imagenFalla: That image could not be loaded (a cover with initials will be shown).

f.pendiente: Leave it as pending (only the name is required; it will not be recommended by the assistant until completed)
f.pesoAyuda: On BoardGameGeek it appears as “Weight”. Easy < 2 · Medium < 2.8 · Hard < 3.5 · Expert otherwise.
f.experiencia: Type of experience (used by the assistant)
f.descripcionPlaceholder: What the game is about, how it is played…
f.notasPlaceholder: Something to check, where the data comes from…

ayuda.disenadores: Type a name and press Enter
ayuda.experiencia: E.g.: Deck building, Laughs and creativity…

bgg.ayuda: Replaces the fields BGG knows (it does not touch setup, theme, experience or party). Check the data before saving.

val.noExiste: The game you are trying to edit no longer exists.
val.imagen: The image must be an address starting with http:// or https://.
val.enlace: The link must start with http:// or https://.
val.anio: The year does not look right.
val.jugMin: Enter the minimum number of players (1 or more).
val.jugMax: Enter the maximum number of players.
val.jugMaxMenor: The maximum cannot be lower than the minimum.
val.durMin: Enter the minimum duration in minutes.
val.durMax: Enter the maximum duration in minutes.
val.durMaxMenor: The maximum duration cannot be lower than the minimum.
val.prep: Enter the setup time in minutes (0 if immediate).
val.peso: The difficulty (weight) must be between 1 and 5.
val.modo: Choose at least one game mode.

copia.explicacion: Export all your games to a .json file to keep them or move them to another device. When importing, the games in the file are added and, if you already have one with the same id, it is replaced; the rest are left untouched.
copia.aviso: Your games are stored only in this browser (on this device): if you clear the site data they are lost. Export a backup from time to time.
copia.importado: Import done: {nuevos} new games and {actualizados} updated.
copia.jsonInvalido: The file is not valid JSON.
copia.sinLista: The file does not contain a list of games.

datos.danados: The saved data is damaged; it has not been modified.
datos.sinId: A game without an id cannot be saved
datos.noGuardado: The games could not be saved (storage blocked or full).

bgg.cargado: Data for “{nombre}” loaded into the form; nothing has been saved yet.
bgg.espera: BGG asks you to wait a little (too many requests). Try again in a minute.
bgg.sinDatos: BGG returned no data for that id.
bgg.escribeId: Enter the BGG number or paste the listing address (boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/…).
bgg.sinConexion: Could not connect to BGG (or to the intermediate service). Check your connection and try again.
bgg.sinPeso: BGG does not have a difficulty (weight) for this game yet: it was left as it was.
bgg.sinVotos: BGG has no votes for recommended number of players.
bgg.descripcionIngles: The description is in English: translate it before saving.
